reviews.author: Vivaan Rathi
reviews.body: Makeup se pehle lips ko properly prep karna lip colour ya gloss ke overall appearance ko more polished feel de sakta hai.

reviews.author: Aisha Malhotra
reviews.body: Fruity-inspired lip care beauty routine mein ek fresh and cheerful aesthetic introduce karta hai. Sweet melon concept especially summery aur refreshing feel deta hai.

reviews.author: Radhya Arora
reviews.body: Sweet melon-inspired scrub practical lip exfoliation aur refreshing fruity aesthetic ko ek saath bring karta hai.

reviews.author: Samar Patil
reviews.body: Sweet melon theme ordinary exfoliation step ko thoda more enjoyable bana deta hai.

sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text: Start with clean, dry lips. Take a small amount of lip scrub and gently massage in circular motions for 30–60 seconds. This helps remove dead skin, dryness, and flakiness. Wipe off or rinse gently.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Sweet Melon Flavored Lip Scrub

Gentle Exfoliation | Smooth Lips | Sweet Melon Care

Get ready to buff away dryness with the Sweet Melon Flavored Lip Scrub — a juicy, fruity, and gentle lip-care scrub made to smooth rough, dry, and flaky lips.

Its sugar-like exfoliating texture helps remove dry build-up and dead skin from the lips, making them feel softer, fresher, and more polished. The Sweet Melon flavour adds a fresh, fruity, and refreshing self-care touch, making every lip-care routine feel soft and enjoyable.

This lip scrub is perfect before applying lip balm, lip mask, lipstick, or lip tint, as it helps create a smoother base and improves the overall look and feel of your lips.

Use it as a weekly lip-care step to keep your lips feeling soft, smooth, and ready for daily hydration.

A fruity little scrub made for smooth lips, soft texture, and sweet melon freshness.

Note: For external use only. Use gently on lips and avoid over-scrubbing. Do not apply on cracked, irritated, damaged, or bleeding lips. Patch test before use.
